findings.title: Materials' 50-point lens gap signals earnings bet
findings.body: Materials trades at a 50-point percentile gap between its trailing and forward lenses, the widest in the table. The market is underwriting 119 percent earnings growth, a bet that reported earnings are a poor guide to the next twelve months.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' forward plunge versus rich trailing
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward percentile has dropped 18 points in a week while its trailing percentile sits at 84. The forward lens is pricing in a 44 percent earnings surge, but the speed of the de-rating suggests the market is losing faith in that forecast.

findings.title: Real Estate's week-long valuation collapse
findings.body: Real Estate's forward percentile fell 31 points in a single week, the largest weekly move in the table. That drop, against a modest 5 percent implied earnings decline, points to a repricing of the sector's risk rather than a change in its fundamentals.
